thread:
Karen T.: Hi team! First day in Amsterdam :netherlands: Kit arrived but a couple problems: the USB-C cable in the box is stiff and only charges (no data), the dock's USB-A ports won't see my keyboard, and when I try to join CompanyCorp-Enterprise the Mac prompt says it needs a machine certificate. I opened ticket IT-5321. Any quick troubleshooting while IT triages?

Maya (IT): welcome Karen :wave: Quick triage q's: 1) Which dock model is printed on the sticker? 2) is the USB-C cable labelled 'Thunderbolt/USB4' or just 'USB-C'? 3) can you run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and paste the small portion around the dock entry?

Karen T.: Dock label: "Narwhal Dock USB4 Pro" S/N NWH-77X. Cable has no marking, looks like the thin white charge cable. system_profiler output (trimmed):
```
Thunderbolt Bus:
  Narwhal Dock USB4 Pro:
    Current Available (mA): 9000
    Speed: Up to 10 Gb/s
```
So it's showing limited power and only 10Gb/s.

Samir K.: That explains no USB hub enumeration. Two likely causes: cable is charge-only or dock negotiated a fallback PD table. Quick test: if you have any other USB-C cable (phone charger USB-C) try swapping — some phone cables are data-capable and will show higher speeds. If not, we can ship a certified USB4 cable and a short USB-Ethernet dongle.

Maya (IT): For the machine cert: check Self-Service -> Devices -> Enroll Device. If enrollment times out, reply here and I'll push an enrollment token to your email. I just created IT-5321 and set priority P2.

Karen T.: I'm remote and don't have another cable. Shipping the certified cable + dongle would be great. Also, curious: is there a quick way to verify the dock firmware version before we apply any flashes?

Samir K.: On the dock we expose a small USB descriptor with firmware version. In macOS `ioreg -p IOUSB -l` will show it under the dock node (look for FirmwareRevision or ProductVersion). If you're comfortable pasting that output I can confirm. If not, we'll just ship the parts; if firmware is the root cause we'll schedule a flash.

Priya S.: fwiw I hit a similar issue last month  the cable swap fixed it. Maya, can we include a prepped EU stick with the cable so Karen can flash without waiting?

Maya (IT): Good call. We'll send: 1x certified USB4 100W cable (EU), 1x USB 3.0 Ethernet dongle, 1x prepped USB stick with Narwhal fw v1.0.4 and quick steps. Tracking: https://ship.example/track/1ZEU12345678900000 ETA 2 business days. Also sending enrollment token to karen.t@redwood.com now.

it-bot: Ticket IT-5321 updated by Maya (IT): "Outbound cable + dongle + prepped USB stick; enrollment token sent."

Karen T.: Excellent, thanks so much! I'll try the Self-Service enroll link once the token arrives and update here after kit arrives and I test. Really appreciate the quick response :smile: 

Maya (IT): Awesome — if the dongle shows up and you can get online we can remote guide the fw step. Leave the ticket open until you confirm both cert and peripherals working.

Karen T.: Will do. Thanks everyone!
